parts.label: (b)
parts.question_text:
An interference pattern is produced with the arrangement shown in Fig. 6.2.
Laser light of wavelength λ of 546 nm is incident on the slits S_{1} and S_{2}. The slits are a distance
0.13 mm apart. The distance between the slits and the screen is 85 cm.
Two points on the screen are labelled A and B. The path difference between S_{1}A and S_{2}A is
zero. The path difference between S_{1}B and S_{2}B is 2.5 λ. Maxima and minima of intensity of
light are produced on the screen.
